justification: A depicts a specific frontal anthropomorphic figure with headdress, incised facial/head bands, arms curving to the torso and a prominent central disc motif, whereas B shows only vertically framed panels and shallow niches whose forms are too featureless to yield comparable iconography beyond a vague upright figure-like recess. The only correspondence is the generic notion of an upright frontal figure/panel in stone; none of A's distinctive motifs (the disc, the banded headdress, the flanking arms) recurs in B.
